name: shutdown-observations
purpose: Collect fresh Tk state/workflow and capture source observations for candidate record renewal on the verified shutdown successor wheels
reuse: Exact hash-retained Windows/Linux wheels, existing interpreter/dependency sites and existing external WSL lavapipe. No native/SDK compilation, source clone, new environment or dependency installation
constraints: One sequential observer child, recorded actual exit/wait; existing 56 state/capture assertions, eight-branch workflow, capture scenario and five active controls unchanged. Source/native observations grant no installed observer/profile admission. Existing v1 records stay unchanged during collection
terminal_cleanup: Retain source/script/license identities, observations and meaningful failures; inspect/apply registry-aware cleanup before the next experiment
